name: Monastero Santa Rosa
insider_take: This 17th-century monastery turned luxury retreat perches dramatically on clifftops 1,000 feet above the Mediterranean, offering an ethereal escape where ancient spirituality meets modern indulgence.
whats_special: The hotel occupies a former Dominican convent dating to 1681, featuring original frescoed ceilings, vaulted stone chambers, and terraced gardens cascading down the cliff face. The infinity pool appears to float above the sea, while the Michelin-starred restaurant Il Refettorio serves elevated cuisine in the original monastery refectory with breathtaking coastal views.
pro_tip: Book the Belvedere Suite for exclusive access to a private garden terrace with panoramic views, or time your visit during the summer classical concerts held in the atmospheric monastery courtyard.
dont_miss: The historic Path of the Gods hiking trail starts nearby, offering spectacular views of Capri and Positano. Explore the medieval town of Conca dei Marini below, home to the emerald Grotta dello Smeraldo sea cave, and visit the nearby 13th-century Amalfi Cathedral with its striking Arab-Norman architecture.
pros: Historic 17th-century monastery converted into luxury hotel
Spectacular cliffside location with panoramic Amalfi Coast views
Michelin-starred Il Refettorio restaurant with exceptional cuisine
Infinity pool carved into the cliff face
Award-winning spa treatments in authentic monastery setting
cons: Remote location requiring winding coastal road access
